id.description: scripting-4c Rev 2 W1 — a session id is 1–64 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Every client in the repository and at PROD sends a 36-character UUID, so nothing real is refused; 64 leaves room for a non-UUID id. The bound is what keeps a visitor's id out of every log line, out of the forwarded `from`, and out of the avatar node's name (Rev 2 M1/S1).

displayName.description: Optional display name sent by client (pre-brief #9)

scriptRunner.description: scripting-4b-2 F-L6 / scripting-4c S2 / scripting-4d G-L9: 1 declares this tab runs behaviour graphs (4b-2); 2 also handles forwarded `activate` (4c); 3 runs 4d graphs. Election and handover require 3. The enum keeps 1 and 2 so an unreloaded 4c tab still connects and is simply never the host.
